parsed.explanation: No criminalisation, gender-identity discrimination prohibited since 2005 with extended equality coverage, 2023 legal recognition reform, marriage equality, a conversion-practices prosecution and parliamentary ban endorsement, active civil society, large Pride attendance, and a government that publicly defends trans travellers against document-based refusals abroad — documented acceptance plus functioning, trans-facing protections. Negatives: no statutory hate-crime offence (motive only in police records), rising reported hate-crime counts (though raw, reporting-driven, no denominator), and dated LGBT-wide youth violence findings — mostly local-sphere. Resident-facing gaps (minor care rationing, 40% care-access survey, undated; 30-day LGR reflection) are climate signals, not visitor exposure. Border handling, screening and facility access are unresolved open questions, not established exposures; their absence of evidence caps the score below 0.95. No universal-exposure measure or organised targeting documented.
